text_block_list.text:
While walking down the hallway, I heard 
Grass Wonder's voice coming from inside 
the nurse's office.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much for the medicine. Well 
then, excuse me~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm fine. It's just a tiny, throbbing 
headache—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, oh dear. It seems the medicine is 
taking a while to kick in~.

"Grass Wonder seems to be suffering from a 
headache. I might need to be a little 
extra considerate..."
